title: An Active Learning Framework for Inclusive Generation by Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's performance on hate speech and offensive text targeting women by calculating the error-ratio-variance of human-verified counter-narrations and measuring the reduction in offensive text counts post-style-transfer.
